questions.question: Which generation were you most likely born into if you were born between 1997 and 2012?
questions.explanation: Generation Z (born 1997-2012) grew up with smartphones and social media. Millennials were born 1981-1996 and Baby Boomers 1946-1964.

questions.question: What does it mean that Gen Z are "digital natives"?
options: They have grown up with digital technology as a natural part of life
They were born inside a computer
questions.explanation: Digital natives have never known a world without the internet and digital devices - technology is a natural part of their lives.

questions.question: Which generation grew up WITHOUT the internet?
questions.explanation: Generation X grew up before the internet became common. Millennials experienced the transition, and Gen Z grew up fully online.

questions.question: What is "climate anxiety"?
options: Worry and stress among young people about the future of the planet
An app for tracking the climate
questions.explanation: Climate anxiety is the worry many young people feel about climate change and the planet's future - a typical challenge for today's youth.

questions.question: Why does youth slang change so quickly?
options: Language is alive, and young people constantly create new expressions through social media and culture
Schools rewrite the dictionary every year
The government decides new slang annually
questions.explanation: Youth slang is a living part of language, spreading and changing rapidly through social media, music and gaming culture.
